bagPolicy.summary: The Cooperage hasn't published bag policy details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

parking.summary: You can park in the shared lot north of the building, and street parking has no restrictions. A paid lot is also at 205 E. National Ave.
parking.quote: We have a shared parking lot, north of the building, that you are welcome to park in.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by The Cooperage. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Outside food and drinks aren't allowed. Food from the food trucks outside and drinks bought at Boone & Crockett are welcome.
allowed: Food from the food trucks outside
concessions.quote: You can not bring in your own food and beverages.

accessibility.summary: The Cooperage hasn't published accessibility details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

reEntry.summary: The Cooperage hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: The Cooperage is a 21+ concert venue, and guests under 21 aren't admitted to public ticketed events.
ticketPickup.quote: We are a 21+ concert venue and do not allow those under the age of 21 to the public, ticketed events.

gates.summary: The entrance is off the parking lot. Walk toward the river, and you'll find it in Boone & Crockett's patio, closest to the river.
gates.quote: The Cooperage entrance is located in the parking lot.
